# Seamline Studio

> Seamline Studio designs and hand-builds websites for small businesses in Belper, Duffield, Ambergate and across Derbyshire, UK. Tagline: "Websites, made to measure." No templates and no website builders.

## Services and prices
- Simple website: £280, one-off. One-page, mobile-friendly site with the business's photos, menu or services, opening hours, contact details and map; a booking button for systems such as Fresha or Booksy; one round of changes.
- Hosting & care: £20 per month, or £200 per year (two months free). Includes a .co.uk domain name registered in the client's name, hosting and security, free email forwarding (for example hello@yourbusiness.co.uk), and small text and photo updates.
- Larger sites, more pages or extras: quoted on request.
- Free homepage mock-up before you commit.

## Process
1. Brief: a conversation about the business and what the site needs to do.
2. Design: the client sees and shapes the design before building starts.
3. Build: hand-coded, quick to load, tested on every screen size.
4. Launch: live on the client's own domain, with easy ways to keep it up to date.

## Recent work
- Zen Visuals (https://zenvisuals.co.uk): full redesign for a wedding and commercial photography and film studio in Derbyshire.
- Jolly Felties (https://jollyfelties.com): bilingual landing page for lifelike needle-felted animal sculptures.
- Derwent Fire Compliance: new site for a chartered fire risk assessor in Belper (in progress).
